item.title: RTD train involved in crash with vehicle that ran stop sign, agency says
item.description: The L line train was southbound near 28th and Welton streets in Denver when a vehicle ran a stop sign and "made impact," RTD officials said.

item.title: CU Buffs aim to break the odds in visit to No. 5 Houston
item.description: Tad Boyle has faced Houston on the road before. It’s been over 40 years, with over a thousand games on the sideline since. But Boyle remembers that game clearly.

item.title: University of Denver to close Ricks Center for Gifted Children next year
item.description: The University of Denver will close the Ricks Center for Gifted Children after the 2026-27 academic year.

item.title: Renee Good was ‘slow to anger, quick to love,’ her father tells AP

item.title: Nearly 150 BMWs destroyed Wednesday in Thornton wildfire, cause still undetermined
item.description: About 150 BMW cars were destroyed as the Huron fire spread across 10 acres in Thornton on Wednesday after several days of dry, windy weather, according to local officials.

item.title: Texas Tech linebacker Jacob Rodriguez represents perfect fit for Broncos defense | Renck & File
item.description: The combine workout confirmed what he put on film at Texas Tech. Rodriguez operated as Vin Diesel in the Red Raiders’ defense. He was fast and often furious.

item.title: As Avalanche funk persists, the door has cracked open for Minnesota Wild and Dallas Stars
item.description: Even with a historic first half of the season from the Colorado Avalanche, the Minnesota Wild and Dallas Stars have been stalking the league leaders and hoping for a chance to catch them.

item.title: Littleton-based developer declares bankruptcy after $900K Alaska verdict
item.description: A local development firm is bankrupt and shutting down after a judge in Alaska determined that it walked off a job at a naval base and now owes $900,000 to the general contractor.

item.title: NFL Combine: Broncos’ Davis Webb ‘very involved’ in meetings with draft prospects
item.description: Multiple top offensive prospects in this 2026 NFL draft class have told The Denver Post this week that Davis Webb has been a focal point of conversation with them.

item.title: Lu Dort foul on Nikola Jokic sparks fight in Nuggets’ overtime loss to Thunder
item.description: Nikola Jokic had everything going for him on a night when he was ready to fight. Except for his jump shot.
